---
# "By the numbers" county report. Layout follows report/wireframe.typ.
#
# county/state below are the report parameters: typst-show.typ passes them
# into the report() template (header band, footer), and the setup chunk
# passes them to R/data-viz.R (data filtering). `county` must match the
# `county` column in the cleaned data (bare name, no "County" suffix).
#
# All Typst definitions live in typst-template.typ; this document only calls
# them. Render with: quarto render report/report.qmd
county: San Diego
state: California
format:
  typst:
    template-partials:
      - typst-show.typ
      - typst-template.typ
    keep-typ: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Quarto executes this document from report/, where the repo root's .Rprofile
# does not run, so activate the renv library explicitly.
Sys.setenv(RENV_PROJECT = normalizePath(".."))
source("../renv/activate.R")

# The YAML metadata above is the single source of the report parameters;
# data-viz.R falls back to its own defaults only when run interactively.
focus_state <- rmarkdown::metadata$state
focus_county <- rmarkdown::metadata$county

# All figures and report data come from the shared data-viz script.
source(here::here("R", "data-viz.R"))

# Emit a raw Typst block from an asis chunk.
typst <- function(...) {
  cat("\n```{=typst}\n", ..., "\n```\n", sep = "")
}

# glue with << >> delimiters so Typst's own braces pass through untouched.
# .envir forwards the caller's environment so this works inside mutate().
tglue <- function(..., .envir = parent.frame()) {
  str_glue(..., .open = "<<", .close = ">>", .envir = .envir)
}

# ACS vintage, read from the import script so the sources note stays in sync.
acs_year <- read_lines(here::here("R", "import-data.R")) |>
  str_subset("^acs_year <-") |>
  str_extract("\\d{4}") |>
  as.integer()
acs_range <- str_glue("{acs_year - 4}–{acs_year}")

# Export the figures the Typst layout embeds. SVG via svglite (named
# explicitly so renv::snapshot() keeps it in the lockfile).
fig_dir <- here::here("report", "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_svg <- function(name, plot, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, name),
    plot,
    device = svglite::svglite,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
}
# Full-width figures match the 5.8in content width (us-letter minus the
# 1.35in x margins set in typst-template.typ) so fonts render at true size.
save_svg("county-map.svg", county_map, 3.2, 3.2)
save_svg("race-plot.svg", race_plot, 5.8, 3.4)
save_svg("income-plot.svg", income_plot, 5.8, 1.7)
```

```{r}
#| label: typst-values
#| output: asis

# Values computed in R that the body text references, passed to Typst as
# `#let` bindings. Values are Typst strings, which also keeps "$" from being
# read as math markup.
typst(tglue(
  '
#let focus-county = "<<focus_label>>"
#let focus-state = "<<focus_state>>"
#let n-counties = "<<n_counties>>"
#let focus-population = "<<scales::comma(focus_population)>>"
#let focus-income = "<<scales::dollar(focus_income, accuracy = 1)>>"
#let acs-range = "<<acs_range>>"
#let generated-date = "<<str_squish(format(Sys.Date(), "%B %e, %Y"))>>"
'
))
```

```{=typst}
// ---- Big numbers + county locator map ----
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.5in),
  column-gutter: 0.4in,
  align: horizon,
  [
    #stat(focus-population, "Total population")
    #v(0.25in)
    #stat(focus-income, "Median household income")
  ],
  image("figures/county-map.svg", width: 100%),
)

#section-title(
  [Total Population],
  subtitle: [Every #focus-state county, ordered from most to least populous],
)
```

```{r}
#| label: population-table
#| output: asis

# The population table cells: n_table_cols side-by-side county/population
# pairs separated by spacer columns, filled top to bottom, left to right
# (population-table() in typst-template.typ builds the matching columns).
# Typst tables are a flat cell stream, so short columns are padded with empty
# cells to keep later rows aligned. Three columns is the most that fits the
# 5.8in content width without wrapping names; the " County" suffix is dropped
# so names stay on one line (the column header already says "County").
n_table_cols <- 3
rows_per_col <- ceiling(n_counties / n_table_cols)

county_cells <- population_by_county |>
  mutate(
    county = str_remove(county, " County$"),
    cell = tglue(
      '..county-cell("<<county>>", "<<scales::comma(total_population)>>", focus: <<tolower(is_focus)>>),'
    ),
    col = (row_number() - 1) %/% rows_per_col,
    slot = (row_number() - 1) %% rows_per_col
  )

table_rows <- map_chr(seq_len(rows_per_col) - 1, function(s) {
  pairs <- map_chr(seq_len(n_table_cols) - 1, function(cl) {
    cell <- county_cells |> filter(col == cl, slot == s) |> pull(cell)
    if (length(cell) == 1) cell else "[], [],"
  })
  paste(pairs, collapse = " [],\n  ")
})

typst(tglue(
  '
#population-table(
  <<n_table_cols>>,
  <<paste(table_rows, collapse = "\n  ")>>
)
'
))
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak()

// ---- Comparison charts ----
#section-title(
  [Population by Race/Ethnicity],
  subtitle: [Share of total population in #hl[#focus-county] and #hl-gray[#focus-state] as a whole],
)

#image("figures/race-plot.svg", width: 100%)

#section-title(
  [Median Household Income],
  subtitle: [#hl[#focus-county] among #hl-gray[all #n-counties #focus-state counties]; dots are spread vertically only to avoid overlap],
)

#image("figures/income-plot.svg", width: 100%)

#v(1fr)
#sources-note(acs-range, generated-date)
```
